mechanismExerciseRules.B1: Exercise is pair-bound. Both pair regions must be confidently assigned to the same materialized panel group with panel evidence used; actual regionDirections determine horizontal/vertical/mixed classification. Page-level booleans are insufficient.
mechanismExerciseRules.C1: A c1-boundary-positive pair counts only when CONTROL has a relevant confidently assigned region and C1_ONLY changes that same region to explicit unassigned/ambiguous with changed guarded candidate membership.

C2.gutter: Count a qualification pair only when its uncertain-node label participates in a diagnostic relation edge with rule unique-gutter-between-hard-panels.
C2.negative: One-sided/nonunique slice counts only when an explicit uncertain node receives no relation edge.
C2.overlap: Count a qualification pair only when its uncertain-node label participates in validated-overlap-bridge-right-before-left.
C2.pairPrecedence: Count a qualification pair only when its uncertain-node label participates in an uncertain-* production pair-precedence edge.
C2.safety: Conflict/cycle slice counts only when C2 introduces uncertain-relation-conflict or a C2-specific precedence-cycle and finalOrder equals fallbackOrder with no panel evidence.

C3.negative: Count rejection only when original segmentation is one fewer-than-two-groups box, recoveryReason begins rejected-, assignments and relationEdges are empty, finalOrder equals fallbackOrder, and usedPanelEvidence is false.
C3.positive: Count only when original segmentation is one unreliable fewer-than-two-groups box, recovery is accepted as recovered-merged-frame, exact acceptance reason is emitted, and panel evidence is materially used.

mechanismExerciseRules.pairBinding: All exercise evidence is computed from diagnostic facts and must bind to predeclared qualification pairs; no human boolean may cause PASS.

B1.name: frozen-v2-orientation-aware-local-order
semantics: Use the exact frozen production tier partitioning reused by v2.
Direction h/hr normalizes to horizontal; v/vr normalizes to vertical; all other values normalize to ambiguous.
Within horizontal subruns order by x_center ascending, then y_top ascending, then source_index ascending.
Within vertical subruns order by x_center descending, then y_top ascending, then source_index ascending.
Each ambiguous item is its own singleton subrun and is source-index deterministic.
Schedule subruns by minimum y_top ascending, maximum doubled x-center descending, minimum source_index ascending, then orientation enum value.
Mixed tiers preserve the exact frozen subrun scheduling; no reinterpretation of B1 is permitted.
B1 may use actual TextBlock direction/orientation plus geometry and source index; OCR text and confidence are forbidden.

C1.invalidation: Any Sobel aperture, morphology kernel/iterations, contour/boundary preprocessing, or coordinate-convention change that affects the current 3x3 local boundary support requires re-derivation and a new experiment identity.
C1.name: guarded-boundary-confidence
rule: Use region geometric center and detected panel boxes only.
Confidence-bearing containment is inset by exactly 1 px from every detected panel edge.
Exactly one guarded candidate means confident membership.
Zero guarded candidates means explicit unassigned uncertainty.
Multiple guarded candidates means explicit ambiguous uncertainty.
No nearest-panel assignment or other coercion is permitted.
C1 changes confidence-bearing membership only; it does not alter region geometry, identity, text, confidence, or count.

C2.determinism: Hard edges precede relational edges; candidate/bracket enumeration and active panel order are deterministic; topological tie keys are exactly those in the bound candidate/production sources.
C2.name: geometry-only-relational-scheduling-for-uncertain-nodes
rule: Uncertain regions remain explicit uncertain nodes and are never silently materialized as panel members.
Hard panel precedence edges are materialized first and dominate scheduling.

Unique gutter bridge is accepted only for one unique same-level hard-panel bracket, with nonempty endpoint groups, center within the geometric gutter, and intrusion into each panel no greater than the frozen width fraction.

Validated overlap bridge is accepted only for an ambiguous node with exactly two candidate panels, both nonempty, frozen one-dimensional x-overlap and y-overlap conditions, unequal panel x centers, both panels present and adjacent in active hard-panel order.

Pair-precedence fallback applies the unchanged production _panel_precedence_edges function to each confident panel box versus the uncertain region box, then requires predecessor and successor evidence, a non-conflicting interval, and exactly one adjacent slot in active hard-panel order.
One-sided evidence, no predecessor/successor, nonunique slot, conflicting relation, otherwise ambiguous relation, hard-panel conflict, or any graph cycle fails closed.
Relation conflict produces exact whole-page fallback with fallbackReason uncertain-relation-conflict.
Precedence cycle produces exact whole-page fallback with fallbackReason precedence-cycle.
The fallback is the unchanged explicit text-independent manga-tier fallback used by the merged candidate.

C3.eligibility: Only original segmentation that is unreliable with reason fewer-than-two-groups and exactly one original box is eligible.
C3.name: conservative-single-merged-frame-recovery
rule: Require exactly one deduplicated strong complete frame anchor.
Require exactly one deduplicated occlusion-supported companion distinct from the anchor.
Only side spans geometrically covered by the strong anchor may be removed when computing visible support.
Every remaining visible side must meet the frozen minimum visible-span and coverage constraints.
An occlusion-supported candidate must retain an adjacent strong corner before refinement.
Endpoint refinement is bounded by the frozen scale-relative tolerance with the frozen absolute floor.
Recovered boxes are deterministically sorted and must pass the unchanged production _validate_boxes topology validation.
Zero or multiple strong anchors fail closed.
Zero or multiple companions fail closed.
Insufficient long sides, visible support, refinement support, or invalid/nested/material-overlap topology fails closed.
A rejected recovery returns the exact original fallback before assignments or relational edges materialize.

replayGuard.concurrency: GitHub Actions concurrency group is keyed by qualification identity with cancel-in-progress false.
replayGuard.duplicateDefinition: A prior workflow_dispatch run with the same canonical run-title identity whose exact 'Execute frozen qualification exactly once' step is in-progress or completed with any non-skipped conclusion.
replayGuard.implementation: Read Actions workflow runs and jobs using actions:read; reject an observed duplicate before environment setup.
replayGuard.limitation: Repository administrators can delete GitHub Actions run history. With the qualification workflow intentionally read-only and no durable write permission, this guard cannot create an immutable repository ledger. The frozen safety mechanism therefore combines canonical identity, matching run title, execution-step inspection, and concurrency; deletion of authoritative Actions history is an administrative trust-boundary limitation and must be recorded with qualification evidence.
replayGuard.preflightFailureConsumption: A run that fails before the execution step does not consume the identity.

scoringContract.canonicalization: page scores sorted by pageId; slice names sorted; wrong pairs sorted lexicographically; canonical JSON uses sorted object keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN, trailing newline
scoringContract.correctPair: observed final ordering places GT earlier region before GT later region
scoringContract.exactSequencePage: observed scored region sequence exactly equals GT readingOrder after declared unscored regions are removed
scoringContract.forbiddenMetric: IoU is not a reading-order correctness metric
scoringContract.globalComparablePairs: For each page, all unordered region pairs in GT order are converted to directed earlier-before-later pairs.
scoringContract.globalWrongSet: canonical sorted union/list of per-page wrong tuples
scoringContract.groundTruth: GT reading sequence defines all comparable precedence pairs; declared qualificationPairs bind slice/mechanism evidence.
scoringContract.mechanismExercise: reported separately from correctness; a correct final order cannot itself establish exercise
scoringContract.pairwiseAccuracy: correct_pairs / comparable_pairs; exact rational value retained with deterministic decimal serialization
scoringContract.perSliceMetrics: same pair metrics computed only from qualificationPairs declaring that slice
scoringContract.stableIdentity: stable region IDs from the sealed input/annotation contract
scoringContract.wrongPair: observed final ordering reverses a comparable GT precedence pair

stopAndAntiReplay.candidateChange: Any candidate source, mechanism, threshold, fallback, diagnostic behavior affecting experiment semantics, scorer/verdict/schema change requires a new experiment identity and a genuinely new held-out corpus after pre-freeze.
stopAndAntiReplay.contamination: Once the Execute frozen qualification exactly once step begins for an identity, its corpus is observed/contaminated for future tuning.
stopAndAntiReplay.failOrInconclusive: FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE never authorizes tuning and replay on the same corpus identity.
stopAndAntiReplay.oneExecution: Exactly one observed execution is permitted for one frozen corpus+experiment+execution identity.
stopAndAntiReplay.publicDemo: Public Demo does not substitute for formal held-out qualification.
